stances_toward.note: Occupied and annexed by Russia in 2014 and claimed by Ukraine; the General Assembly voted 143-5-35 on 12 Oct 2022 (ES-11/4) to reject the annexations and affirm Ukraine's territorial integrity, and the 24 Feb 2026 text did the same. DeepState counts Crimea as 100% occupied at the start of 2026. Not a negotiating item for Kyiv.
